【職種番号】#2370
★空席広報番号欄に「整理番号」を記入すること。
乗客や荷物を乗せたバスや１０トン以下の大型車輌の運転。荷物の上げおろしを含めたフォークリフトの操作。米軍施設内、公共の道路・高速道路等で施設間を移動。
★履歴書1枚目12番犯罪歴欄、無い場合は【無し／NONE】と記入

items.employment: 常用雇用 (採用後6ヶ月は試用期間）

・貨物を搭載した大型車輌や乗客を乗せたバス等で公共の道路や高速道路を運転した職務経験があること
・18キロ程度の重量物を持ち上げられること

items.description:
【職種】会計技術職（JRHA）（1表4等級）
【職種番号】#0007
★空席広報番号欄に「整理番号」を記入すること。
在日米軍関連機関での、各種会計伝票の審査・処理、システム入力および確認業務
・契約書等の内容を確認し、各種会計伝票の作成・審査およびシステム処理
・専用の会計システムを用いた日々の資金報告データや経費処理、およびデータの正確性のチェック
・サービス契約や部署間協定の定期的な確認、および提供されたサービスと契約条件の照合作業
・英語と日本語の両方を用いた、伝票処理、メール・文書の作成、および各種問い合わせ対応業務
★履歴書1枚目12番犯罪歴欄、無い場合は【無し／NONE】と記入

items.org_ja: 米国防省防衛財務会計局
items.desc_en_official:
Minimum Qualification 
1. Position Title, Number and Organization: 
    Accounting Technician #0007 
    DFAS/JRHA 
2. Basic Wage Table, Grade, LPL: 
    BWT 1-04, LPL: 2  
3. Language Proficiency Level (LPL): 2 
LPL TOEIC ALCPT(LD) ALCPT TOEFL CASEC EIKEN ~8 Feb 16 8 Feb 16~ PBT CBT iBT 
2 550-729 66-75 75-89 460-549 140-209 50-79 560-869 2nd 
4. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: 
• Work experience at least one year of clerical, technical or administrative duties in any 
field, or completion of two-year junior college or two-year of technical school.  
• Ability to process billing documents, draft correspondence, and handle inquiries in 
both English and Japanese. 
Work Schedule: 
• Work Hours:        40 hours/ week  
• Work Days:          Mon - Fri 
• Work Schedule:   0730-1630                      
Remarks:  
• The duty location/ section / work schedule may be changed at management’s request.  
For any questions or concerns, please contact the JN Staffing Section.   
Main Duties 
Through application of comprehensive knowledge of proper accounting policies and service 
directives, performs quality review of all obligation documents for adequacy, legality, 
propriety, completeness and compliance to appropriate regulation/instruction. 
Processes accounting transactions for commitments, obligations, and accruals from obtained 
purchase requests (Form 9) and contract/receipt of required source documents. Audits each 
transaction to verify the appropriateness and validity of the purchase from the generated 
computer products, other relevant documents accordingly. 
Processes the Merged Accountability Fund Reporting (MAFR) transaction on a daily basis 
using the Integrated Payable System (IAPS) and General Accounting and Finance System 
(BQ). Ensures that all processed transactions are valid and in compliance to established 
regulations/instructions accordingly. 
Prepares and processes Miscellaneous Obligation/Reimbursement Documents (MORDs) 
based on estimates provided by various governmental agencies such as PACAF, 5AF, US 
Forces Japan. 
Performs quarterly examination of contracts and interservice support agreements. Reviews 
the terms of the contract and requirements on established support agreements to ensure that 
all terms are appropriate and in accordance with the services rendered to customers. 
Condition of Employment: 
This position is designated as Mission Essential. Incumbents are required to report to work or 
to remain at work to accomplish the mission of US Forces Japan during emergencies or 
exigent situations. Designations are NOT tied to combat operations or mobilization.
items.description_en:
[Job type] Accounting engineer (JRHA) (1 table, 4 grades)
[Job number] #0007
★Enter the "reference number" in the vacancy publicity number column.
Examination and processing of various accounting documents, system input and confirmation work at US military-related institutions in Japan
・Checking the contents of contracts, etc., creating and reviewing various accounting documents, and system processing
・Daily financial reporting data and expense processing using a dedicated accounting system, and checking the accuracy of data
・Regular confirmation of service contracts and interdepartmental agreements, and verification of provided services and contract conditions.
・Voucher processing, email/document creation, and various inquiry response tasks in both English and Japanese
★Civil history column 12 on the first page of your resume, if you don't have it, write [NONE]
Also, don't forget to write your signature in the job applicant signature field on number 17 on the 4th sheet.
Scope of change in job type: Within the scope of the basic labor contract Appendix I job definition
Scope of work location change: Other U.S. military facilities in Japan

items.title: 歯科補助職
items.description:
【職種】歯科補助職（5表2等級）
【職種番号】#5000

・歯科健診や治療を行う医師の補助を行う。
・患者の血圧、脈拍の計測を行う。
・ガイドラインに従って治療器具や診察室の準備を行い、院内を清潔に保つ。
・診療内容を記録し、ファイリングを行う。
・患者の次回の予約を手配する。
・その他、割り当てられた関連する業務を行う。

items.desc_en_official:
Minimum Qualification 
1. Position Title, Number: 
    Accounting Technician #0007 
    DFAS/JRJC 
2. Basic Wage Table, Grade, LPL: 
    BWT 1-04, LPL: 2  
3. Language Proficiency Level (LPL): 2  
LPL TOEIC ALCPT(LD) ALCPT TOEFL CASEC EIKEN ~8 Feb 16 8 Feb 16~ PBT CBT iBT 
2 550-729 66-75 75-89 460-549 140-209 50-79 560-869 2nd 
 
4. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: 
• Work experience at least one year of clerical, technical or administrative duties in any 
field, or completion of two-year junior college or two-year of technical school.  
Work Schedule: 
• Work Hours:        40 hours/ week  
• Work Days:          Mon - Fri 
• Work Schedule:   730-1630                      
Remarks:  
• The duty location/ section / work schedule may be changed at management’s request.  
For any questions or concerns, please contact the JN Staffing Section.   
 
Main Duties  
Receives and reviews a variety of standardized and recurring accounting 
documents/transactions and some non-standardized transactions in support of assigned 
customers and accounts. Prepares and processes obligation documents and various 
vouchers such as payment vouchers, journal vouchers, and collection vouchers in 
compliance to established guidelines and instruction. 
Reviews documents to verify accounting data and mathematical accuracy; determines 
necessary accounting transactions and codes and enters required data into a computerized 
system or onto required form(s) respectively.  Reviews transactions for validity, corrects or 
directs correction of invalid or incorrect entries, and reviews the trial balance or summary 
account.  Distributes payment vouchers to proper organizations and maintains appropriate 
payment records. 
Prepares and processes required bills for ‘no check drawn’ collections and payments from 
submitted disbursement and collection vouchers; verifies that all documents are accurate 
and processes bills in compliance to established guidelines and instruction. 
Establishes/maintains records of appropriate collection and payments, and transaction files 
accordingly to ensure that all handled transactions is being monitored and can be tracked 
accordingly.

items.description:
【職種】管理分析職 （目標レベル1表7等級／研修生6等級、5等級）研修生から採用された場合には、目標レベルの訓練を受けた後、昇格する事が可能です。応募者の資格や経験等によっては、目標レベルの1表7等級として採用される場合もあります。

★空席広報番号欄に「整理番号」を記入すること。
労務課課長の専門的アドバイザーとして、日本政府が負担する在日米軍従業員約23,000人分を超える労務費予算管理を担当し、補佐する。日本全国の各軍間における労務費予算の配分と相互調整を行う。統合人材委員会（JLRC）のメンバーと、労務費人件費に関する諸問題を調査、提示、調整を行う。

items.description:
【職種】虫疫係（2表4等級）＊目標職位：ぺストコントロール機械操作工（2表5等級）
この職位は育成職位であり、目標職位はぺストコントロール機械操作工（2表5等級）です。目標職位に就くには必要な害虫駆除研修コースを修了し、有効な研修修了証を保持していることが条件となります。昇格は監督者の要請により行われます。

• Work Hours:        40 hours/ week  
• Work Days:          Mon - Fri 
• Work Schedule:   0730-1630

• The duty location/ section / work schedule may be changed at management’s request.  
For any questions or concerns, please contact the JN Staffing Section.   
 
Main Duties  
Performs accounting work involved in maintaining operating budget for DFAS Japan. 
Processes financial data into standardized automated data system used to monitor the 
execution of the operating budget for all goods and services purchased. Inputs the 
obligations into the system as goods and services are received. 
Keeps track of all expense line items in the system by accounting codes. Periodically runs 
standardized reports on all expenses accrued by line items, and reviews against the 
corresponding budget for each line item. 
Performs duties involved in maintaining time and attendance for the office. Serves as a 
timekeeper for LN employees. Reviews local national civilian payroll sheets to ensure the 
forms are properly filled out and signed, and sends to the payroll office. 
Performs Customer Service Representative (CSR) duties and submits remedy tickets to 
resolve U.S. civilian payroll issues through the Defense Civilian Payroll System (DCPS), 
COGNOS, and/or e-Biz systems.

Work Schedule: 
• Work Hours: 40 hours / week                         
• Work Days: 5 days / week 
• Work Schedule: Shift Schedule 
                          1. 0530-1430 (Recess: 1130-1230) 
                          2. 0600-1500 (Recess: 1200-1300) 
                          3. 0800-1700 (Recess: 1400-1500) 
                          4. 1230-2130 (Recess: 1600-1700)                        
                          *Work schedule and rest days are subject to change   
Remarks:   
• The duty location/section/work schedule may be changed at management’s 
request. For any questions or concerns, please contact the JN Staffing Section. 
Main Duties 
As a senior cook, assists the supervisor in oversight and providing direction in the kitchen. 
Monitors individual work schedules, oversees preparation of a full range of raw or 
precooked foods; provides on-the-job training to subordinate cooks on food preparation 
and associated topics, food standards and utilization of leftovers to ensure that the skill and 
knowledge are enhanced and up to date. 
Prepares and cooks a variety of menu items including regular and special diet entrees and 
dessert items using standard recipes and cooking techniques. Evaluates varieties of raw 
and cooked food items to decide if they are fresh and whether cooked foods are done by 
their appearance, consistency, texture, and temperature. Plans, coordinates, and times 
work assignments to assure food items are prepared on time and are at the proper 
temperature. 
Cleans and/or oversees cleaning of the food preparation area and cooking utensils 
routinely in accordance with sanitation standards. Ensures the food facility health 
inspections meet or exceed the grading standard of satisfactory or higher as determined by 
routine health inspections.
